chinese: 也许他们早上不觉得饿，
english: Maybe they don’t feel hungry in the morning,

chinese: 或者他们太忙了没时间吃东西。
english: or they are too busy to eat anything.

chinese: 但食物能给我们提供能量。
如果我们不吃早餐，很容易感到困倦，并且难以专注于工作或学习。
english: It is easy to feel sleepy and find it hard to focus on our work or studies if we don’t eat breakfast.
Some people also eat too many sweet things.

chinese: 冰淇淋、糖果和巧克力很美味，
english: Ice cream, sweets, and chocolate are delicious

chinese: 但它们通常含有大量糖分。
english: but they usually have lots of sugar.

chinese: 为什么不改吃点水果呢？
english: why don’t you have some fruit instead?

chinese: 毕竟，一天一苹果，医生远离我。
english: After all, an apple a day keeps the doctor away.
Remember: You are what you eat.

chinese: 健康饮食意味着吃健康的食物并养成良好的饮食习惯。
english: Healthy eating means eating healthy food and having good eating habits.
